name: Nur Hossain
contribution: Nur Hossain was killed during an anti-Ershad procession in Dhaka on 10 November 1987 and became a lasting symbol of the demand for democracy.
context: His body carried the movement’s demand for the fall of autocracy and the restoration of democracy in the public memory; the killing intensified outrage against authoritarian rule.
impact: Nur Hossain’s name became inseparable from Bangladesh’s democratic movement and is commemorated annually on Shaheed Nur Hossain Day.
seoDescription: Profile of Nur Hossain, tracing links to the 1990 Mass Uprising, anti-Ershad movement, and democratic transition in Bangladesh.

faq.question: How is Nur Hossain connected to the 1990 Mass Uprising?
faq.answer: Nur Hossain is connected to the anti-Ershad democratic movement as Martyr-Symbol of the Movement. Killed in 1987 during the anti-Ershad movement, he became the most enduring martyr-symbol of the democratic uprising.
